name: Chivalric Fire

frame.name: Caster Frame
frame.description:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy projectile attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.

origins.name: Vanguard's Vindication
origins.description: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

origins.name: One Quiet Moment
origins.description: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

origins.name: Gun and Run
origins.description: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

perks.name: Balanced Guard
perks.description: Sword Guard has balanced overall defenses.

perks.name: Relentless Strikes
perks.description: [Light Attack]  : Landing three light-attack hits within a short time grants Sword ammo.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

flavor: And this beast evermore Sir Palomides followed, for it was called his quest.
